asked.item: Does animating a still with Seedance in the generate skill use Blotato Creator credits
How to see what the skill will spend

verdict.reason: The generate skill page says it runs through kie.ai and that provider credits and Blotato credits are separate.

steps.text: The generate skill generates images and videos through kie.ai.
It animates the approved still through kie.ai.
Provider credits and Blotato credits are separate.
The skill quotes estimated credits and remaining budget before spending, and balance.sh checks kie.ai credits.
